answer: An identity registers only through a nullifier registry binding one credential per agent, a prism splitting each applicant into one verifiable line. The credential locks 400 tokens for 60 epochs, slashed 100% on a second registration reusing the nullifier, the onyx record verifiable on-chain in seconds. A watchdog sweeps clusters sharing a funding source, freezing every sponsored identity on the third reveal from one funder. Each fake costs 400 tokens, locked and unrecoverable, so 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens. At the vertex of funding, credential, and payout, one identity passes.
